name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's journey in motorsport began with a childhood fascination for Formula One, fueled by late-night broadcasts and a deep admiration for the engineering prowess behind the machines. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering at the University of Tokyo, focusing on aerodynamics and vehicle dynamics. After graduating, Kenji joined a small Japanese racing team, where he quickly rose through the ranks, demonstrating a keen eye for detail and an ability to optimize car performance.

His reputation for meticulousness and innovative problem-solving caught the attention of Cadillac Racing, who brought him on board to lead their technical department. Kenji believes in a holistic approach to engineering, emphasizing collaboration between departments and a data-driven decision-making process. He is known for his ability to identify subtle performance gains and translate them into tangible results on the track, always pushing the boundaries of what's possible.
